CONTENT_LIBRARY_DESC: Pages, posts, taxonomies, and templates all live in one content library.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_DUPLICATE_DIALOG_DESC: Create a new draft copied from {{name}}.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_DELETE_DIALOG_DESC: Delete {{name}} and all of its versions. This action cannot be undone.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_ARCHIVE_DIALOG_DESC: Archive the current content version of {{name}}.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_UNARCHIVE_DIALOG_DESC: Restore {{name}} from archived back to draft.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_RECORD_DRAWER_DESC: Inspect the record, confirm its editing posture, and continue from the right surface.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_VIEWS_MANAGER_DESC: Save and organize recurring workbench states without turning the library into a permanent rail.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_VIEWS_MANAGER_EMPTY: No saved views yet. Save the current workbench state to reuse it later.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_VIEW_CREATE_POPOVER_DESC: Preview the new view configuration before wiring it to shared persistence.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_VIEW_EDIT_DIALOG_DESC: Adjust the saved view metadata without changing the current workbench snapshot.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_VIEW_SAVE_AS_DIALOG_DESC: Duplicate this saved view with a new name, scope, and personal pin/default settings.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_VIEW_VISIBILITY_HELP: Choose whether this view stays personal or is shared across the workspace.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_VIEW_PIN_STATE_UNPINNED: Keep it out of the top rail
CONTENT_LIBRARY_VIEW_DEFAULT_STATE_ENABL: Use this view as the personal default
CONTENT_LIBRARY_UPDATE_VIEW_DIALOG_DESC: Review the differences between {{name}} and the current workbench before overwriting the saved view definition.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_UPDATE_VIEW_DIALOG_EMPTY: The current workbench already matches this saved view.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_UPDATE_VIEW_DISABLED_TOO: This view already matches the current workbench state, so there is nothing to update.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_SAVE_AS_UNCHANGED_NAME_H: Choose a different name before saving this view as a new copy.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_DELETE_VIEW_DIALOG_DESC: Delete {{name}} from your saved views. This removes the saved configuration, but does not affect any content records.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_SEO_EMPTY: No SEO profile is available for this version.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_SEO_UNSUPPORTED: SEO summary is not available for this record.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_PUBLISH_IMPACT_CLEAR: No publish blockers were detected for this record.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_EMPTY_INITIAL_DESC: Everything here can become a page, post, block, or template.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_EMPTY_FILTERED_DESC: Try another view, clear filters, or broaden your search.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_DESC: Create a draft and choose a starting template.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_CREATE_DESC: Provide a name, then optionally start with a template. Continuing creates a draft and returns you to Content Library.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_SIDE_DESC: This flow creates the draft first, then lets you continue configuration later from Content Library.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRINCIPLE_ONE: A draft can be created before you decide every detail of the content structure.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRINCIPLE_TWO: Templates provide a starting point. Capabilities define behavior.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRINCIPLE_THREE: You can return later and continue configuring the draft.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_DESC: Provide a name, then optionally choose a starting template. You can continue setup later from Content Library.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_SUPPORT: Continuing creates the draft record right away. Choosing a template simply gives it a starting point.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_ASIDE_DESC: Creating the draft first lets the rest of the setup happen on a real content record.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_ASIDE_POINT_T: You can leave and continue later.
Additional setup can happen in a dedicated follow-up step.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_TWO_DESC: Add capabilities and other settings to the draft in the next step.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_FIELD_TITLE_DESC: This name is used to identify the draft in Content Library after it is created.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_START_FROM_DESC: Choose a template if it helps. You can also continue without one.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_FIELD_LOCALE_DESC: Choose the locale you expect to work in first.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_FOOTER_READY_DESC: You can keep configuring it now or return from Content Library later.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_DRAFT_SUMMARY_DESC: This draft now exists in {{locale}} and is ready for further setup.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESETS_DESC: Templates are optional. Choose one if it helps you start faster.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_PAGE_DESC: Best for content that needs its own URL and page layout.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_PAGE_USE_CASE: this content should render as a page with URL, layout, and search metadata.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_POST_DESC: Best for articles, updates, and content published over time.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_POST_USE_CASE: this content belongs in a feed or collection and benefits from categorization.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_REUSABLE_BLOCK_: Best for shared content reused across multiple pages.
the same content needs to stay portable and reusable.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_EMAIL_TEMPLATE_: Best for reusable email content and localized campaigns.
this content is intended for email delivery rather than page rendering.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_TAXONOMY_ITEM_D: Best for categories, tags, and other content used for organization.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_TAXONOMY_ITEM_U: this content is primarily used to classify or organize other content.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_BLANK_DESC: Start with a draft that does not include any predefined capabilities.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_BLANK_USE_CASE: you want to start from scratch and decide the structure later.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_CAPABILITY_PACKS_DESC: Choose the behaviors this content should support.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_ROUTABLE_DESC: Give the content a public URL or path.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_PUBLISHABLE_DESC: Allow the content to move through draft and published states.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_SEO_DESC: Store search metadata alongside the content.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_LAYOUT_BOUND_DESC: Associate the content with a page layout or composition context.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_REUSABLE_DESC: Allow the content to be inserted or referenced in multiple places.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_TAXONOMY_DESC: Use the content to organize or classify other content.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_SCHEDULABLE_DESC: Support scheduled publishing or timed state changes.
